content_sections.heading: About TMC
content_sections.text: Tata Memorial Centre, Mumbai, is a Grant-in-Aid Institute under the Department of Atomic Energy, Government of India. This post is at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital and Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre in Varanasi.

rows.post: Medical Officer (Neuro Surgery & Pediatric Surgery - Common Post)

content_sections.heading: TMC Medical Officer Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 45 years. Age and experience are reckoned as on the date of the walk-in interview. M.B.B.S. Degree recognized by NMC. Candidates with experience in Oncology will be preferred. See the official notification (PDF) for the discipline-specific eligibility of this post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through the walk-in interview. Depending on the number of candidates who appear, the interview may be scheduled for the next day, so come prepared for that. Online interviews will not be conducted.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for TMC Medical Officer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Collect the original documents listed below, along with the required copies. Report between 09:30 AM and 11:00 AM on the interview date. Go to the Office of the Dean (Academics), 5th Floor, DNT Block, Mahamana Pandit Madan Mohan Malaviya Cancer Centre, Sunder Bagiya, BHU Campus, Varanasi - 221005, Uttar Pradesh. Attend the interview in person. Bio-data 10th Passing Certificate M.B.B.S. Degree Medical Council Registration Certificate FMGE Certificate, if applicable Experience Certificates obtained after the M.B.B.S. Copy of Aadhaar Card and PAN Card No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable Four passport-size color photographs with a white background

faq.question: Q1. Is oncology experience compulsory for this post?
faq.answer: No. The mandatory qualification is an M.B.B.S. Degree recognized by NMC. Experience in Oncology only gives a candidate preference.

faq.question: Q2. Can I attend the interview online?
faq.answer: No. The notice says online interviews will not be conducted, so you must come to the DNT Block in Varanasi.

faq.question: Q3. Will the interview finish on 3 November 2026?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. If many candidates appear, the interview may be scheduled for the next day.

faq.question: Q4. Do I need an NOC if I am working elsewhere?
faq.answer: Yes, if it applies to you. The document list includes a No Objection Certificate from the present employer.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The initial tenure is up to six months, and it may be extended according to the Centre's requirements.

faq.question: Q6. How soon would the selected candidate have to join?
faq.answer: The selected candidate may be required to join immediately, once found medically fit.

faq.question: Q7. How is age relaxation applied for an OBC candidate?
faq.answer: An OBC candidate gets 3 years of relaxation on the 45-year limit, counted as on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. How many photographs should I carry?
faq.answer: Carry four passport-size color photographs with a white background.
